headline: School Committee to vote on updated operating protocols and job description for Assistant Director of Special Education.
summary: The meeting includes a Superintendent's Report, an update on the Technical and Adaptive Change Initial Entry Plan, and sub-committee reports from Program, Building and Finance, and Personnel. The committee will vote on updated Gloucester School Committee Operating Protocols and on the job description for Assistant Director of Special Education.
items: Technical and Adaptive Change - Initial Entry Plan Update
Program Subcommittee Meeting report of September 30, 2026 (School Committee Operating Protocols)

Building and Finance Subcommittee Meeting report of October 7, 2026 (Student Activity Accounts-Activity Account Creation - GHS Theatre/Drama, Vote/Recommend FY 26 Activity Balances, Special Education-FY27 Circuit Breaker Reimbursement, NEC Quarterly Update, Out of District Tuition, Out of District Transportation, Future Meetings Arrangement, Budget Transfers)
Personnel Subcommittee Meeting report of October 8, 2026 (review of updated job descriptions for three individual non-union contracts)
Vote on updated Gloucester School Committee Operating Protocols
Vote to approve job description for Assistant Director of Special Education
location: Gloucester High School Library, 32 Leslie O. Johnson Road, Gloucester, MA 01930

**Oral Communication: The public shall have the opportunity at every regular School Committee meeting to be heard under Oral Communications. Oral Communications shall allow any resident who has a request or complaint of any nature relative to the School Committee business to appear before the School Committee, state their problem without debate, and the matter may be referred to the proper sub-committee.

For items that are on the agenda, members of the public may address the Committee with the permission of the Chair. Persons speaking under Oral Communications shall be limited to three (3) minutes each and shall submit a copy of their prepared communication to the Recording Secretary
